cells.gaps: The Strategie nationale de transformation numerique 2025-2035 (successor) was validated in August 2025 but no adopting act is on record, so it cannot be staged above 2; its text is not shown public. The 2026-2028 ministry roadmap and the PND 2026-2030 are not national-class instruments. Reporting is claims of delivery (fibre km, services) measured against no stated target. No dated event inside the last twelve months.
cells.note: Instrument: Strategie nationale de developpement du numerique 2021-2025, adopted with public text, but its period ended in 2025 and the successor NDTS 2025-2035 is only validated, so the cell is stage 2, lapsed. Stage 3 needs a strategy inside its period.
